mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS flgtTypeId, f.flgt_acname AS type, case when isnull( vts.flgt_type_id ) then '0' else '1' end AS bind FROM T_FLGT_TYPE f LEFT JOIN T_FLGT_TYPE_STAFF vts ON f.id = vts.flgt_type_id AND vts.staff_id = #{staffId}

SELECT id, flgt_acname AS flgtAcname, alarm_time AS alarmTime, interval_time AS intervalTime FROM T_FLGT_TYPE
and flgt_acname LIKE CONCAT('%',#{flgtAcname},'%')
SELECT id, flgt_acname AS flgtAcname, alarm_time AS alarmTime, interval_time AS intervalTime FROM T_FLGT_TYPE where flgt_acname = #{flgtAcname}

SELECT f.id AS flgtTypeId, f.flgt_acname AS type, case when isnull( vts.flgt_type_id ) then '0' else '1' end AS bind FROM T_FLGT_TYPE f LEFT JOIN T_FLGT_TYPE_STAFF vts ON f.id = vts.flgt_type_id WHERE vts.staff_id = #{staffId}

SELECT f.id AS flgtTypeId, f.flgt_acname AS type, v.id AS vehiTypeId, v.type AS vehiType, case when isnull( f.id ) then '0' else '1' end AS bind FROM T_VEHI_TYPE v LEFT JOIN T_FLGT_TYPE_VEHI vts ON v.id = vts.vehi_type_id AND vts.flgt_type_id = #{flgtTypeId} LEFT JOIN T_FLGT_TYPE f ON f.id = vts.flgt_type_id

SELECT f.id AS flgtTypeId, f.flgt_acname AS type, case when isnull( vts.flgt_type_id ) then '0' else '1' end AS bind FROM T_FLGT_TYPE f LEFT JOIN T_FLGT_TYPE_STAFF vts ON f.id = vts.flgt_type_id WHERE vts.staff_id = #{staffId} AND f.flgt_acname = #{type}
SELECT sfvh_vehi_no AS sfvhVehiNo FROM T_STAFF_VEHI WHERE sfvh_staff_id = #{staffId} limit 1

SELECT f.id AS flgtTypeId, f.flgt_acname AS type, v.id AS vehiTypeId, v.type AS vehiType, case when isnull( f.id ) then '0' else '1' end AS bind FROM T_VEHI_TYPE v LEFT JOIN T_FLGT_TYPE_VEHI vts ON v.id = vts.vehi_type_id LEFT JOIN T_FLGT_TYPE f ON f.id = vts.flgt_type_id LEFT JOIN T_VEHI tv ON v.type = tv.vehi_type where tv.vehi_no = #{sfvhVehiNo} and f.flgt_acname =#{type}
